correctness.rationale: Enumerated independently all 12 affine lines on F3^2 from translations of four direction classes. For every one of 4096 line-erasure masks enumerated all 511 nonempty subsets of nine points and formed exactly the simplices containing none of the retained 3-point lines. Constructed mod2 boundary bit matrices and exact ranks with augmentation r0=1; obtained the full dimension-by-erasure-count spectrum agreeing with all seven b3 multiplicity rows in RESULT.md. At zero erasures b2=1,b3=11; for erasures 1..7 only b3 may survive. For eight erasures nine cases have only b4=1, precisely four retained lines through a point (nine pencils); for nine erasures four cases have only b5=1, precisely three retained parallel lines; all other patterns at m>=8 are mod2 acyclic. Each pencil case is a cone attachment with link (S0)^*4≅S3 and resulting S4; each parallel three-line case is join (S1)^*3≅S5. Exhaustive enumeration additionally verifies every predecessor of these special cases restores mod2 acyclicity. This is a finite exact proof, not a claim over all affine planes or integral coefficients.
residual_risks: Only AG(2,3), only reduced GF2 homology for complete spectrum; exceptional selected cases have integral sphere types but no complete all-pattern integral classification. Mod2 acyclic does not mean contractible; no full persistence module/ranks between arbitrary erasure patterns.
